newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Casinos Austria end junkets at Reef.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Casinos Austria end junkets at Reef.

text.p: Casinos Austria International Ltd (CAI) said on Wednesday that junket and premium players gaming at the Reef Casino in Cairns in north Queensland will not be available until further notice.

CAI said this decision follows the failure by the Reef Casino owner, the Reef Casino Trust, to have the standby facility supporting junket and premium play extended beyond December 31 or to arrange any alternative support.
"This is a major disappointment to Casinos Austria because the casino has established itself as a favoured destination of junket and premium play for Asian high rollers," CAI said.
"The financial impact of the suspension of junket and premium player activity on Casinos Austria is difficult to determine," CAI said.

"If this position continued for any length of time, overall revenues from the casino would be reduced, but there would be much less impact on the fees payable to Casinos Austria due to the costs associated with premium and junket play," it said.

It said Casinos Austria has no immediate plans for any other changes at the casino, but it would continue to work with Reef Casino Trust management towards re-introducing junket and premium play as soon as possible.
Casinos Austria is 61.5 percent owned by Casinos Austria International Holdings Gmbh.
CAI shares closed 1.5 cents lower at 36 cents.
